name: Penneech
description: Penneech is a 17th-century British 2-player trick game. Trump changes each trick (turned from stock). The 7â™¦ (Peneech) is highest when diamonds are trump and scores 7. Ace/K/Q/J of trumps score 5/4/3/2. First to 61 wins.

history.origins: Described in Charles Cotton's Compleat Gamester (1676). One of the earliest documented trick games.
history.cultural: Inn game; Cribbage board used for scoring.
history.evolution: Diamonds 7 = highest when trump; unique per-trick trump.

setup.deck: Standard 52. Diamonds: 7 ranks above Ace when diamonds trump.

rules.objective: First to 61. Score for A(5), K(4), Q(3), J(2) of trump; 7â™¦=7 when diamonds trump.
rules.gameplay: 1. Turn top of stock = trump for first trick. 2. Non-dealer leads. 3. Follow suit; higher wins (or trump). 4. Winner scores any scoring trump in trick. 5. Turn next stock card = trump for next trick. 6. Repeat. 7. No A or face = throw in, redeal. 8. 7â™¦ beats all diamonds when diamonds trump.

strategy.basic: Save scoring trumps for when that suit is trump.
strategy.intermediate: Lead to waste opponent's high trumps.
strategy.advanced: Count scoring cards; control stock turn.
tips: Throw in if no Ace or face.
